usage: deskops atoms crossroad [-h] --title TITLE --content CONTENT
                               [--root ROOT]
                               path

positional arguments:
  path               Domain path such as pizzeria.carta; its parent path needs
                     a crossroad first.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --title TITLE      Short title of the domain area.
  --content CONTENT  Written description of what hangs below this path.
  --root ROOT        Target repository root.
